meta.source: Written for the KERYX live operator console (Electron, Windows). Dark only.

tokens.name: bg-0
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the modules and the console's 6px gutter between panels (.console overrides the gutter token's 8px). The top bar and THE window's frame sit directly on it (no panel of their own).

tokens.name: bg-1
tokens.usage: Every module (panel) surface. Lists sit on it; in the top bar, the search field and the Ver and bell chips; a folded panel's 28px strip.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Raised fields inside a panel: inputs, the search/command field, popovers and menus, hover tint of a row or glyph. Slide and verse rows sit on it.

tokens.name: bg-3
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected neutral state (a selected tab, an open menu trigger, an active segment of a neutral switch), the next slide's row, the drag ghost's card. The fourth and last grey step.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, the 1px separator between slide and verse rows, the line under a header's band, the 2px gap between Multiview quadrants. Decorative, never carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: The 1px splitter line on hover, the hover line of a field, the menus' ring, the hatch of an empty monitor. Never text.

tokens.name: fg-1
tokens.usage: Content text (13–14px) and labels of the row in hand on bg-1, bg-2 and bg-3. 15.9:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: UI labels (12px), glyphs at rest, clock digits. 7.2:1 on bg-3.

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Metadata (11px), section headers, placeholder text, done items of the Setlist, and the quiet 1px focus line of a field (5.5:1 on bg-2; text fields never get the gold ring). 4.9:1 on bg-3 — never go greyer than this for text.

tokens.name: air
tokens.usage: ON AIR outside the slide lists: the dot of the Programa's pill while on air, the 2px left bar of an on-air list row (Setlist), a Bíblia verse cell on air. The Programa monitor has no frame while simply on air. Slides and verses on air are brand gold, not air. A mark colour: 4.7:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: air-fg
tokens.usage: Red text on bg-1/bg-2: the Programa pill's title while on air, 'NO AR AGORA', an on-air list row's title. 6.5:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: air-fill
tokens.usage: Red fills: the Encerrar and Excluir buttons (kx-btn-air) and the 'drop to send' hint over the Programa while a library row is dragged there. Text on it is on-state (white, 5.0:1); hover and pressed step darker (air-fill-hover, air-fill-pressed).

tokens.name: air-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a red fill button (Encerrar, Excluir…). Darker, never lighter: white on it 5.9:1.

tokens.name: air-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed red fill button. White on it 7.3:1.

tokens.name: air-tint
tokens.usage: 10% red wash behind an on-air list row (Setlist) or Bíblia verse cell, always paired with its air mark (the 2px bar or the cell's line). Never alone. Slide and verse rows on air use the gold --live-bg instead.

tokens.name: prev
tokens.usage: PREPARED (Prévia). The frame of the Prévia monitor, the 2px left bar of a prepared list row, the Conectada dot of an output. 5.8:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: prev-fg
tokens.usage: Green text on bg-1/bg-2: the Prévia's badge, 'Conectada', the prepared item's time. 9.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: prev-fill
tokens.usage: Green fills: 'Enviar ao ar' where it exists (Bíblia, Escola bíblica, Mídia) and a switch that is on. Text on it is on-state (white, 5.1:1); hover and pressed step darker.

tokens.name: prev-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on 'Enviar ao ar' (kx-btn-prev). Darker, never lighter (a lighter green, or prev itself at 3.2:1, takes white under 4.5:1): white on it 6.0:1.

tokens.name: prev-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed 'Enviar ao ar'. White on it 7.4:1.

tokens.name: prev-tint
tokens.usage: 10% green wash behind a prepared list row, with its 2px prev bar. Slide and verse rows in the Prévia take a 24% prev wash over bg-2, without a bar.

tokens.name: rh
tokens.usage: LOCKED (Travar telas): nothing new goes to the screens. The dot of the Programa's pill and its frame while locked, the banner's top rule, the output status dot. 5.0:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: rh-fg
tokens.usage: Blue text on bg-1/bg-2: the 'TELAS TRAVADAS' banner text, 'Travado' in the Programa's pill, 'Prévia · travado' on the Prévia's badge. 8.4:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: rh-fill
tokens.usage: 'Destravar' on the lock banner (24px, like every banner button). Text on it is on-state (white, 4.7:1); hover and pressed step darker.

tokens.name: rh-fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on 'Destravar' (kx-btn-rh). Darker, never lighter: white on it 5.6:1.

tokens.name: rh-fill-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed 'Destravar'. White on it 6.9:1.

tokens.name: rh-tint
tokens.usage: 10% blue wash of the lock banner.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: WARNING or FAILURE: output reconnecting or disconnected, missing file, font not installed, a theme with no background, an edition from the internet. Dots, hatches, the 2px bar, the Programa's frame on a failure. 9.0:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: warn-fg
tokens.usage: Amber text on bg-1/bg-2: 'Reconectando… tentativa 2', 'Arquivo não encontrado', the Saídas status with a problem. 11.5:1 on bg-1.

tokens.name: warn-tint
tokens.usage: 10% amber wash of the recovery banner and the reconnecting hatch (alternated with bg-0 stripes).

tokens.name: on-state
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on air-fill, prev-fill and rh-fill. Never on bg-1/bg-2 (use fg-1).

tokens.name: on-warn
tokens.usage: Text on a warn fill (the amber PiP label 'Reconectando', the 'sem fundo' mark). 9.1:1 on warn.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The KERYX gold: the logo mark, the underline of the environment on screen (KERYX | BÍBLIA), the 2px focus ring of controls (never of a text field), the fill of ordinary primary actions such as Salvar or Novo culto (kx-btn-brand), and the slide or verse ON AIR in the Slides column, No ar and the Bíblia's lists (--live, its wash --live-bg). 5.5:1 on bg-3. Never the Programa's pill, the Prévia, Enviar ao ar, a locked state or a warning; one or two gold cues per region.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on a gold button.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed gold button (on-brand on it: 4.7:1). Never text on bg-2/bg-3.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: 10% gold wash, very sparse: behind the item chosen for editing, an empty Temas slot on hover, with a gold edge.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on brand fills: the gold button's label, the logo mark's K. 6.7:1 on brand.

tokens.name: screen-bg
tokens.usage: The black of a projected screen: Tela preta, the ground behind a background image, the letterbox of a monitor.

tokens.name: screen-fg
tokens.usage: Projected text: lyrics, verses, announcements on a background image, with the screen-text shadow.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Telemetry only: the grey line under a title, timestamps, counts, key, length, tooltips' shortcut. Never the name of what is on air or prepared (live-title, next-title). Always fg-3 or fg-2, always tabular numerals.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Module and section headers, uppercase, fg-3; a folded strip's standing name. A listhead never repeats the page title.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, menu items, inputs, the top bar. fg-2 at rest, fg-1 when the control is the one in hand.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside UI text: the status label, the active segment of a switch, the primary button's label.

styles.name: content
styles.usage: Titles in lists: songs, media, Setlist items, layers. fg-1.

styles.name: content-lg
styles.sample: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira…
styles.usage: Reading text: slide text in the Slides column, Bible verses in the reading view. One line per lyric line (ending in '…' when too long); verses wrap. The largest size on the console except clocks.

styles.name: live-cap
styles.usage: A monitor's state word (the Prévia's badge: 'Prévia', 'Prévia · travado'), in the state's text colour (prev-fg, rh-fg). The Programa has no state word: its pill's dot says it.

styles.name: live-title
styles.usage: What is on air, once per screen, where a monitor carries a caption. fg-1.

styles.name: next-title
styles.usage: What is prepared, where a monitor carries a caption. fg-1.

styles.name: alert-title
styles.usage: What failed, in an output banner. The state's text colour.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The clocks in the top bar and the figures of the player and the timers. Tabular numerals, fg-2.

styles.name: countdown
styles.usage: Countdowns and timers inside the console (never on the console for anything else). Tabular numerals.

styles.name: screen-lyrics
styles.sample: Tua voz me chama pelo nome
styles.usage: Lyrics on the projected 1920×1080 screen (scaled by the monitor: 5.2% of the screen width). screen-fg with the screen-text shadow.

styles.name: screen-verse
styles.sample: Porque Deus amou o mundo de tal maneira…
styles.usage: Bible text on screen; the reference line beneath it uses screen-ref.

styles.name: screen-ref
styles.usage: The reference under a projected passage and the song title on the first slide. Uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: The grid unit. Gap between a glyph and its label, between stacked rows of metadata.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a row and a control; the gap between a panel header's controls (8px, as in the windows' bar).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: A panel header's text and last button from the panel's edge; padding of a popover or menu.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of a dialog body; the width of an icon glyph.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Empty-state inset; vertical rhythm inside the brand book only.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: The token's 8px; the console overrides it to 6px (.console --gutter) — one gap between every container, and a splitter IS the gap (never a second gap beside one). Also the inset of the grid from the window edge.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: Height of rows, controls and tabs; a panel header in Compacta; a band's controls. Panel headers are 32px otherwise, and their controls 24px.

tokens.name: row-comfortable
tokens.usage: List rows and panel headers in the Confortável density (Ver › Densidade): 14px titles, up to two lines. Compacta keeps row (28px). The default, Automática, is Compacta on a grid under 820px tall, else Confortável.

tokens.name: topbar
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar (it sits on bg-0, without a panel).

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Width of the state bar on a list row's left edge (not on slide and verse rows) and of the focus ring of a control.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menu items, list-row cards (inset 4px, 2px apart), timeline blocks, the monitor's inner screen.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Modules, popovers, menus, dialogs, THE window, banners.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: State dots (6px), the seek handle of the player, the Programa's pill and the top bar's search field and chips.

shadow.note: The console has no shadows inside panels. Popovers that float over the grid get one hairline-plus-ambient shadow so they separate from the module under them; projected text gets a text shadow for legibility on any background.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Small floaters that ride the grid: tooltips, the toast, the Camadas drawer, drag ghosts. Menus override it with a full line-strong ring (console .kx-pop).

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Floating dialogs over the console (Configurações, the background library, the views): the menus' line-strong ring at 60% — visible but quieter — with a lighter, shorter shadow (owner 2026-10-14).

tokens.name: screen-text
tokens.usage: A text-shadow (not a box-shadow) under projected lyrics and verses so screen-fg reads on bright backgrounds.

timing.note: One easing, one fast duration. Hover, focus, selection and state changes transition background-color, color, border-color and opacity over 120ms ease-out. Motion with a purpose: a panel fold and No ar folding away take 180ms, rows gliding and the card settling while dragging a list 180ms, THE window easing between its sizes. Projected screens use the theme's slide transition and fade out on Esc, Limpar, Tela preta and Logo (Configurações › Telas e saídas › Transições). prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes the console's transitions (outputs ignore it).

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, selection and state changes on the console.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: The console's easing for hover, state changes and dragging in a list.

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: Done items of the Setlist, hidden layers, a disabled control, the inert fold chevron. Applied to the whole row, text included.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: The amber hatch over a monitor whose output is reconnecting: the stripes let the last frame show through.
